concerns.text: Task T001 (Create directory tree) is not linked to any functional requirement (FR) or success criterion (SC) in the specification. While useful for project scaffolding, it is an over‑reach relative to the spec and should be either anchored to a missing FR/SC or removed.

Task T002 (Write requirements.txt and add to quickstart) also lacks an explicit FR/SC mapping. This setup step is not required by the spec and should be tied to a requirement (e.g., reproducibility) or omitted.
